text:
sam: FYI CI started failing on the nightly SAST+DAST run, looks like the scanner can't fetch artifacts from our artifact-store. error: 403

tanya: ugh. did something change with the scanner service account or bucket ACLs?

liam: I saw an alert — keystore decrypt failing for the scanner service principal earlier at ~6765432050. KMS returned AccessDenied.

priya: @liam can you paste the exact KMS error? also tagging @ops-oncall in case this impacts staging deploys.

liam: sure: ```
Error: AccessDeniedException: Caller does not have permission to use key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-efgh
RequestId: 9a3b2c
```

sam: that explains the 403. scanner tries to decrypt the artifact-encryption key to pull blobs. last change: we rotated a role binding in infra last week (PR #4217). could be related.

tanya: quick triage idea: (1) confirm the scanner service account still has kms:Decrypt on that key (2) check audit logs for iam:PutRolePolicy or kms:RevokeKeyRotation events around the rotation PR time (3) if confirmed, temp-grant decrypt to unblock CI and open a rollback.

priya: sounds right. I can check CloudTrail/Audit logs. running query now: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AttachRolePolicy --start-time 2024-08-01`

sec-bot: [scan-runner] Running nightly-scan job 2024-08-02T01:00Z - status: failed (exit 2) :eyes:

liam: cloudtrail shows an `DetachRolePolicy` + an inline policy removal on role `scanner-runner-prod` at 2024-07-31T18:23Z by infra-bot. that PR wanted to tighten S3 read perms but looks like it also removed a KMS allow.

sam: can we get a minimal temporary fix? i.e., add kms:Decrypt to `scanner-runner-prod` scoped to the key — we'll revert after we ship. we need CI green for releases. :pray:

ops-oncall: I can apply a scoped inline policy for 30m now, will monitor. applying: 
```
PolicyDocument:
  - Effect: Allow
    Action: kms:Decrypt
    Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-efgh
    Condition: 
      StringEquals:
        aws:RequestedRegion: us-west-2
```

priya: once ops patches, can someone re-run the nightly pipeline? also we should capture the artifact-store access logs to make sure no other service lost access.

tanya: +1. after CI green, we need a short RCA: why did infra-bot's tighten policy remove the KMS binding? missing test? policy linting false positive?

liam: preliminary cause: infra template had permissive wildcard that looked unused, infra-bot replaced it with explicit S3-only statements but a separate `kms:Decrypt` binding lived in a different attached policy that the bot removed as part of policy consolidation.

sam: lessons: (a) scan runner perms must be a single source of truth (b) pre-merge policy-change job should run a 'simulated access' check for dependent services (c) add an audit alert if kms:Decrypt is removed from roles that own artifact pulls.

priya: i'll draft a one-paragraph incident note and attach the timeline + PR refs. also opening a follow-up ticket for adding a CI-access-checker to infra pipelines.

ops-oncall: CI re-run started 6765432158. watching logs.

sec-bot: [scan-runner] nightly-scan job 2024-08-02T01:01Z - status: success :tada:

sam: nice. after this we should schedule a quick sync with infra team to add the simulated-access step. cc: @tanya @liam @priya

tanya: i'll ping infra on the dry-run and policy-lint enhancement. will also propose a short playbook change: "on policy-change affecting roles with artifact access, require approval from sec-oncall".

liam: adding: update our audit playbooks to include a canned query for `kms:RevokeKey` and `DetachRolePolicy` and a dashboard for late-night policy churn.

priya: note saved. i'll attach the cloudtrail snippets and the temporary policy we applied to the incident doc.

sam: thanks y'all. closing thread after RCA is posted. :white_check_mark:
